q: Match the area to the room: 20.25 sq. m.
n: 4.5 × 4.5 = 20.25. Remember this: "33.45 for the big two" — the major operating room and the delivery room are both 33.45 sq. m. Private and isolation rooms are 9.29; every bed elsewhere is 7.43; every bassinet 3.72. X-ray rooms grow by table: 7.5 → 14.0 → 20.25.

q: True or false: The delivery room and the major operating room have the same minimum area.
Fill in the blank: Isolation room with toilet = ___ sq. m.
Which unit area is per BASSINET?
n: 3.90 is the viewing area, not per bassinet.
